summary: Backend-only testing for SEO prerender iteration 6: og:image tags on /api/prerender + static build/<route>/index.html files generated by frontend/scripts/prerender-seo.mjs. Created /app/backend/tests/test_seo_prerender_iter6.py with 47 parametrized tests. All 47 iter6 tests PASS. Existing iter5 regression suite (11 tests) also PASSES. Discovered ONE non-blocking bug: prerender script is not idempotent — re-running yarn prerender against an already-prerendered build/*.html file appends duplicate JSON-LD script tags and a second <main id='__seo_prerender'> block instead of replacing them.

minor.issue: Script is NOT idempotent. Second run of `yarn prerender` (without re-running `yarn build:no-prerender` first) duplicates injected content: JSON-LD blocks and the <main id='__seo_prerender'> element appear twice. Fix: strip any previously-injected SEO nodes before merging, OR always read from a clean shell snapshot. Reproduced: md5sum of build/index.html changed between two consecutive `yarn prerender` runs; diff shows duplicated JSON-LD Organization/WebSite scripts and a second <main id='__seo_prerender' data-prerendered='true'> appended.

action_items: Make prerender-seo.mjs idempotent: either strip existing injected <script type=application/ld+json>/<main id=__seo_prerender> blocks + previously replaced <title>/<meta> tags before re-injecting, OR keep an untouched shell (e.g. build/index.html.shell) and always merge from that shell. Currently `yarn build` (which chains build:no-prerender + prerender) works fine because build:no-prerender rewrites index.html first — but standalone `yarn prerender` reruns will corrupt output.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency: prerender-seo.mjs should snapshot the CRA shell once (build/index.html untouched or copied to build/_shell.html) and inject into a copy each run; otherwise repeated runs progressively bloat every generated file.
og:image implementation is solid: always emitted, absolute URLs, secure_url + width/height/alt + twitter:image + twitter:image:alt all present and consistent per-route.
BlogPosting JSON-LD correctly includes an `image` field matching the og:image; falls back to /HeroImage.png when post has no cover_image (verified).
Unknown paths still return 404 as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter6 suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_prerender_iter6.py and covers: (1) og:image absolute+correct per route [/, /solutions, /solutions/business-apps, /brands/roomz], (2) secure_url/width/height/alt/twitter:image parity, (3) blog og:image + BlogPosting JSON-LD image field, (4) unknown route 404, (5) 5 static build files present with React bundle+title+desc>50chars+canonical+JSON-LD+<main id=__seo_prerender> containing <h1>, (6) at least one blog slug dir with index.html, (7) titles differ across routes with keyword checks (UAE/IT, ERP/Business, ROOMZ), (8) home vs roomz og:image differ. Note: idempotency bug in yarn prerender — if you regenerate, always run `yarn build:no-prerender` first. Full `yarn build` (which chains both) is safe.
rca of the issue: prerender-seo.mjs reads build/index.html as the shell each run and injects SEO nodes into it via string append inside <head> / after </header> style merge. Because it also writes back to build/index.html itself, the next run treats the already-injected file AS the shell, so injection happens on top of previous injection — producing duplicated JSON-LD and duplicated <main id='__seo_prerender'>. Mitigation: (a) preserve a pristine shell (build/_shell.html) written by build:no-prerender; (b) or detect+strip <!-- seo:start -->/<!-- seo:end --> markers before injecting; (c) or regex-strip any <main id='__seo_prerender' ...>...</main> and previously injected <script type='application/ld+json'> tags before re-injection.
